description_en: Queries the operation logs of Anti-DDoS Origin
description_zh: 查询DDoS原生防护的操作日志
name: DescribeOpEntities

parameters.help_en: The paging Settings for the current page number in a paged query
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The paging Settings for the number of Operation logs per page in a paged query. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置每页包含操作日志的数量。最大值：50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. Operation logs generated after this time are queried
parameters.help_zh: 设置开始时间，查询在StartTime后产生的操作日志。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. Operation logs generated before this time are queried
parameters.help_zh: 设置结束时间，查询在EndTime前产生的操作日志。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The field by which to sort the operation logs. Set the value to opdate, which indicates that the operation logs are sorted by operation time
parameters.help_zh: 设置操作日志的排序字段。取值固定为opdate，表示按照操作时间排序
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order of the operation logs. Valid values:

ASC: ascending order
DESC: descending order

Default value: DESC
parameters.help_zh:
设置操作日志的排序方式。取值：

ASC：表示按照正序排序。
DESC：表示按照倒序排序。

默认：DESC
parameters.name: order_dir

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html operation to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Origin instances
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS原生防护实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html查询所有DDoS原生防护实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default resource group is used
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html operation to query the IDs of all regions supported by Anti-DDoS Origin
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例所在地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The operation type. Valid values:
3: attach an IP address
4: unbind an IP address
5: decrease the quota
6: deactivate blackhole filtering
7: Reset quota on blackhole filtering deactivation
8: recover burstable protection
9: add an Asset group
10: delete an Asset group
11: enable daily 95th percentile bandwidth
12: enable monthly 95th percentile bandwidth
13: periodically switch between daily and monthly 95th percentile bandwidth patterns
14: shutdown daily 95th percentile bandwidth
15: shutdown monthly 95th percentile bandwidth
16: shutdown burstable clean bandwidth due to overdue payments
17: shutdown burstable clean bandwidth when they expire
parameters.help_zh:
操作类型。取值：
3：绑定IP。
4：解绑IP。
5：降级。
6：解除黑洞。
7：重置解黑洞次数。
8：恢复弹性。
9：添加资产组。
10：删除资产组。
11：开启日95带宽。
12：开启月95带宽。
13：定期切换日月带宽95模式。
14：关闭日95带宽。
15：关闭月95带宽。
16：欠费关闭弹性业务带宽。
17：过期关闭弹性业务带宽
parameters.name: op_action

OpEntities.description_en: The list of Operation logs details

EntityObject.description_en: The operation object, which is the ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance
EntityObject.description_zh: 操作对象，即DDoS原生防护实例的ID

EntityType.description_en: The object type of the operation. The value is fixed as 1, which indicates an Anti-DDoS Origin instance
EntityType.description_zh: 操作对象类型。取值固定为1，表示DDoS原生防护实例

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the log was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
GmtCreate.description_zh: 日志的创建时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒

OpAccount.description_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID used to execute the operation.

If the value is system, the Anti-DDoS Origin service will automatically execute the operation
OpAccount.description_zh:
执行本次操作的阿里云账号ID。

如果取值为system，表示本次操作由DDoS原生防护服务自动执行

OpAction.description_en:
The operation type. Valid values:

3: add protected IP addresses to the Anti-DDoS Origin instance
4: unbind protected IP addresses from the Anti-DDoS Origin instance
5: downgrade the Anti-DDoS Origin instance
6: deactivate blackhole filtering
7: reset the quota on blackhole filtering deactivation
8: resume burstable protection
OpAction.description_zh:
操作类型。取值：

3：表示为DDoS原生防护实例添加防护IP。
4：表示为DDoS原生防护实例解绑防护IP。
5：表示为DDoS原生防护实例降配。
6：表示解除黑洞。
7：表示重置解除黑洞次数。
8：表示恢复弹性防护

OpDesc.description_en:
The operation details. Use a JSON struct to transform the data into a character string representation. The JSON structure contains the following fields:

entity: Object | The operation object. The fields contained in entity vary based on the operation type (OpAction). Details:

    - If OpAction is 3 (add protected IP addresses), entity contains the following fields:
        - ips: Array | The list of assets that are assigned public IP addresses that are attached to the Anti-DDoS Origin instance for protection.

    - If OpAction is 4 (unbind protected IP addresses), entity contains the following fields:
        - ips: Array | The list of assets that are assigned public IP addresses that are unbound from the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

    - If OpAction is 5 (decrease the quota of the instance), entity contains the following fields:
        - baseBandwidth: Integer | The basic protection bandwidth. Unit: Gbit/s.
        - elasticBandwidth: Integer | The burstable protection bandwidth. Unit: Gbit/s.
        - opSource: Integer | The source of the operation. The value is fixed as 1, which indicates that the Anti-DDoS Origin service will automatically execute the operation.

    - If OpAction is 6 (deactivate blackhole filtering), entity contains the following fields:
        - ips: Array | The list of assets that are assigned public IP addresses for which the blackhole filtering status is deactivated.

    - If OpAction is 7 (Reset quota on blackhole filtering deactivation), entity is empty.

    - If OpAction is 8 (recover burstable protection), entity contains the following fields:
        - baseBandwidth: Integer | The basic protection bandwidth. Unit: Gbit/s.
        - elasticBandwidth: Integer | The burstable protection bandwidth. Unit: Gbit/s
OpDesc.description_zh:
操作详情。使用JSON结构体转换的字符串表示。JSON结构体包含以下字段：

entity：Object类型 | 表示操作对象。根据操作类型（OpAction）不同，entity包含的字段不同。具体说明如下：

    - OpAction为3（表示添加防护IP）时，entity包含以下字段：
        - ips：Array类型 | 表示绑定到原生防护实例防护的公网IP资产列表。

    - OpAction为4（表示解绑防护IP）时，entity包含以下字段：
        - ips：Array类型 | 表示从原生防护实例解除防护的公网IP资产列表。

    - OpAction为5（表示实例降配）时，entity包含以下字段：
        - baseBandwidth：Integer类型 | 表示基础防护带宽，单位：Gbps。
        - elasticBandwidth：Integer类型 | 表示弹性防护带宽，单位：Gbps。
        - opSource：Integer类型 | 操作来源，取值固定为1（表示由DDoS原生防护服务自动执行本次操作）。

    - OpAction为6（表示解除黑洞）时，entity包含以下字段：
        - ips：Array类型 | 表示解除黑洞状态的公网IP资产列表。

    - OpAction为7（表示重置解除黑洞次数）时，entity为空。

    - OpAction为8（表示实恢复弹性防护）时，entity包含以下字段：
        - baseBandwidth：Integer类型 | 表示基础防护带宽，单位：Gbps。
        - elasticBandwidth：Integer类型 | 表示弹性防护带宽，单位：Gbps

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of queried operation logs
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的操作日志的总数量
